$comment: Connectors that read the host app bridge state file (MCP_HOST_BRIDGE_STATE / MINDSTONE_REBEL_BRIDGE_STATE) without the vendored hardened reader, test-harness/src/bridge-reader.ts. Found by a sweep on 2026-11-12; some already harden their own reader in part or in full, but none uses the shared copy. scripts/check-bridge-reader.mjs lets these pass so the gate is not red on day one, and fails any other connector that reads the bridge without the copy. RATCHET: this list can only shrink (CI compares it with the base commit's); a connector that adopts the copy fails until it is removed from here.
